hazards.description: The presence of sand and debris on the road surface may indicate poor maintenance and could affect vehicle traction.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway

hazards.name: Roadside Debris
hazards.description: Discarded cardboard and materials are present near the curb, which could potentially obstruct the gutter or blow into the walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right foreground near the curb

hazards.name: Lack of Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no paved walkway for pedestrians, forcing them to walk in the travel lane alongside motor vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire length of the street edge

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block the visibility of pedestrians, especially children, from oncoming drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground and along the right side of the street

hazards.name: Sidewalk Gap
hazards.description: A section of the sidewalk is missing or unpaved, creating a tripping hazard and an inaccessible surface for mobility devices.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground, center-left of the walkway

hazards.name: Frequent Driveway Curb Cuts
hazards.description: Numerous driveways along the block create frequent points where vehicles cross the pedestrian walkway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both sides of the street in front of houses

hazards.name: Unmarked Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The lack of lane markings on a relatively wide street can lead to higher vehicle speeds and unpredictable positioning.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground roadway.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: The right side of the street lacks a paved sidewalk, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved surfaces.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street

hazards.name: Roadway Obstruction (Play Equipment)
hazards.description: A portable basketball hoop is positioned in the street gutter, encouraging children to play in the vehicle travel area.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway near the blue car

hazards.name: Absence of marked crossings
hazards.description: There are no designated or marked points for pedestrians to cross the street, which is particularly hazardous in a residential area.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible roadway

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians attempting to cross the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalks
hazards.description: The total absence of sidewalks forces pedestrians into the travel lane, creating high risk of vehicle-pedestrian collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Both sides of the roadway throughout the visible block.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the roadway edge can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right curbsides where vehicles are parked.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstructions
hazards.description: Trash cans placed on or near the sidewalk narrow the effective walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the curb with no planting strip or furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the right side of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles and large trees near the road edge can block sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Blue car parked on the left side of the street.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crossing
hazards.description: The intersection lacks marked crosswalks, which reduces driver awareness of pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: Center intersection area

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: Large construction equipment and barrels are staged in the roadway and near the sidewalk, blocking sightlines and potentially obstructing the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground

hazards.name: Lack of Curb Ramps
hazards.description: No visible ADA-compliant curb ramps are present at the intersection corners, creating a barrier for people with mobility impairments.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection corners

hazards.name: Sidewalk degradation
hazards.description: Vegetation is growing through cracks in the sidewalk, creating a minor tripping hazard and reducing the effective walking width.
hazards.location_in_image: Sidewalk in the foreground and mid-ground

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Install speed humps or cushions to physically slow traffic to speeds appropriate for a residential street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Add curb extensions at potential crossing points to improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers and shorten the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lighting to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers during low-light conditions.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility marked crosswalks to designate safe crossing locations for residents.

interventions.title: Parking restrictions (Daylighting)
interventions.description: Implement parking restrictions near driveways to improve sightlines for both drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Tree Infill
interventions.description: Plant additional street trees in the grass buffer to create a sense of enclosure, which naturally slows traffic and improves the pedestrian experience.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Maintenance
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk remains clear of debris and household items to maintain a continuous accessible path.

interventions.title: Street Trees
interventions.description: Planting street trees in the grass buffer would provide shade and naturally slow traffic through vertical framing.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lights to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers during dark hours.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to maintain low vehicle speeds appropriate for a residential neighborhood.

interventions.title: Continuous Sidewalk Treatment
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk material and level continue across the driveway to reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one, and preferably both, sides of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Plant street trees between the new sidewalk and the roadway to provide a physical and psychological buffer for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Restricting parking near driveways and potential crossing points to improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Street Tree Planting
interventions.description: Add street trees between the roadway and the new sidewalk to create a buffer and narrow the visual field for drivers, encouraging slower speeds.

interventions.title: Lane Markings
interventions.description: Apply paint markings to define travel lanes and organize traffic flow.

interventions.title: Curb and Gutter Installation
interventions.description: Install raised curbs to physically separate the roadway from the pedestrian zone and manage drainage.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and safety for walkers after dark.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk to at least 6 feet to improve accessibility and comfort for all users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks at the nearest intersections to provide a designated crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during non-daylight hours.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Driveway Design Standards
interventions.description: Ensure driveways maintain the sidewalk level and material to reinforce pedestrian priority.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Completion
interventions.description: Pave the missing section of the sidewalk to provide a continuous, ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Infill
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe pedestrian network.

interventions.title: Daylighting at Driveways
interventions.description: Restrict parking near driveway entrances to improve visibility between exiting vehicles and pedestrians on the grass or roadway.

interventions.title: Obstruction Removal
interventions.description: Enforce local ordinances to keep the public right-of-way clear of private recreational equipment.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer/Planting Strip
interventions.description: Introduce a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to improve pedestrian comfort and safety.

interventions.title: Install Continuous Sidewalks
interventions.description: Construct paved sidewalks on at least one side of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Add Street Lighting
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale or street-level lighting to improve visibility and safety during dark hours.

interventions.title: Driveway Design Reinforcement
interventions.description: Ensure the sidewalk material and level continue across the driveway to signal pedestrian priority to drivers.

interventions.title: Lane Markings and Narrowing
interventions.description: Add painted lane markings to define travel lanes and narrow the perceived roadway width, encouraging slower speeds.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install directional curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces at all corners to ensure accessibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking and equipment staging near the intersection to maintain clear sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Speed Humps or Cushions
interventions.description: Install vertical traffic calming measures to reduce vehicle speeds in this residential context.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during nighttime hours.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks and Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks and ADA-compliant curb ramps at appropriate crossing intervals.
